name: Colleges Crossing bridge run
description: Gravel run under the Colleges Crossing road bridge, between the pipe crossing (km 83.70) and the bridge (km 83.81). Runs fresh into the tidal water below it at low tide.
source: field visit 2026-11-14; position of the bridge from OpenStreetMap

name: Run below the old weir ruin
description: Gravel run just below the old weir ruin. Not drowned at Kholo Creek high water of 1.85 m (4 Jun 2023).

name: Old weir ruin
description: Concrete ruin of the old weir below Mt Crosby weir. Straight concrete edges; the upper limit for reports.

name: Rock formations below the ruin
description: Natural rock pillars and boulders in the pool at km 86.9-87.0, below cliffs.

name: Colleges Crossing road bridge
description: Low-level road bridge (Mt Crosby Rd, state route 37).

name: Pipe crossing below Colleges Crossing
description: Large water pipe on piers crossing the river about 110 m below the road bridge.

name: 275 kV lines above the ruin
description: Three Powerlink 275 kV lines cross at km 87.45-87.60, just above the ruin (lines 838 Blackwall-South Pine, 817 Blackwall-Belmont and one unnamed). Visible in photos around the ruin: a cross-check of a photo's position and direction.

name: 275 kV lines below Colleges Crossing
description: Two Powerlink 275 kV lines cross at km 82.43-82.46 (the same lines as at the ruin).

name: Power line above Colleges Crossing
description: Smaller power line (voltage not recorded) crossing at km 84.59.

name: Colleges Crossing river gauge (BoM 540063)
description: Bureau of Meteorology flood warning gauge 540063, Brisbane River at Colleges Crossing (ALERT). Gauge zero is 0.00 m AHD (since 27 Aug 1999), so its readings are heights in m AHD although the river heights page labels them LGH. Reads nothing below 0.59 m: a flat 0.59 means the water is at or below that. Reports only changes of 0.05 m. Road crossing level 2.67 m. Exact sensor position not confirmed; shown at the bridge.
source: BoM Queensland flood warning networks, Sections 5 and 6 (station details, gauge zero and datum); BoM river heights page for 540063

name: Gauge plate on Colleges Crossing bridge
description: Small square gauge plate on the side of the headstock of the southernmost row of piers, about 1.0 m from the vertical end of the headstock. Graduated 2.1 m (bottom edge), 2.2 m (middle), 2.3 m (top edge), ticks every 0.05 m. height_m_ahd is the bottom edge. Agrees with AHD to within about 0.05 m: on 2026-11-15 the water reached the lower tape band on the pylon (0.70 m AHD by the plate) at about 12:56; gauge 540063 read 0.64 m at 12:57 and 0.69 m at 13:05. The underside of the headstock is 0.40 m below the plate's bottom edge, about 1.70 m AHD.

name: Tape bands on pylon below Colleges Crossing bridge
description: Two bands of white electrical tape (17 mm wide, wrapped once, overlap on the south side) on a vertical pylon: southernmost row of piers, second pylon from the eastern end. Upper band as close to the top of the pylon as possible, just under the headstock (about 1.69 m AHD); lower band 1.00 m below it (about 0.70 m AHD; height_m_ahd is this band). Heights assume the headstock underside is level between the plate and this pylon. Temporary: the tape will weather and should be checked each visit.
